correctness.rationale: Let J=T+T* and B be the alternating Jacobi tail with top essential edge L=a+b. Schur complementation for λ>L gives F(λ)=λ−c²/λ−d²g(λ); g decreases to zero, g(L+)=1/b, so F has a unique zero above L iff c²+(L/b)d²>L². At/below edge the 2-periodic Jacobi solutions are not ℓ², so rotationally symmetric numerical range is open; above it an eigenvector yields the closed disk. Fixed S=c²+d² gives R=S+(a/b)d², producing listed allocation intervals, and g(L+η)=1/b−sqrt(2a/(b³L))sqrt η+O(η) yields the quadratic coefficient b³/(4aLd⁴) for w−L/2. Read actual CHECK.py finite Jacobi/inertia diagnostics; the spectral proof, not finite sections, supplies infinite-domain conclusion.
